chunks: Whoever supports two daughters, two sisters, two paternal aunts, or two maternal aunts, they will shield him from the Fire.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.حَجَبَتَاهُ: they will shield or screen him
key_terms.عَالَ: supported, maintained, and took responsibility for

ai.seo_question: How does caring for daughters or female relatives protect a person from the Fire?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great virtue of caring for female relatives and fulfilling responsibility toward them. It presents such care as a cause of protection from the Fire, showing the spiritual merit of family support and compassion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4699 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever takes care of two daughters, two sisters, two paternal aunts, or two maternal aunts, they will shield him from the Fire."
